jobs.title: Associate, Applied Behavioural Research, AI Transformation
jobs.description_text:
About Us
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 $100M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
Joining Legora means three things.
We 
lean in: 
ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We 
fight for excellence:
 high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We
 grow together:
 as a team and with our customers.
Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
About the role
Legal work is being reshaped by AI faster than most firms can measure. Our AI Transformation & Applied Behavioural Research function exists to close that gap: we study how lawyers and legal teams actually adopt, trust, and build skill with AI, and we turn that evidence into changes across our product, customer enablement, and go-to-market motion.
As an Applied Behavioural Researcher on the team, you will bring rigor to how we measure adoption and capability growth, not just usage. You'll design the studies, build the instruments, and work the data yourself, then translate what you find into recommendations that product, customer success, and leadership can act on. This is a hands-on, mid-level role for someone who wants to do the analysis personally rather than only oversee it, while still being trusted to shape what we study next.
You'll sit close to real legal teams and real deployments, so the questions you're answering are grounded in what's actually happening in firms today, not hypothetical adoption curves.
Responsibilities
Design and run mixed-methods studies on how lawyers and legal professionals build real proficiency with AI tools, distinguishing genuine capability growth from surface-level usage.
Build and validate the surveys, interview protocols, and quantitative measures the team relies on, so findings hold up to scrutiny from product, customer, and executive stakeholders.
Analyze usage and outcome data directly, using standard research tooling, to surface patterns in how adoption succeeds or stalls across different firms and practice areas.
Translate research findings into concrete recommendations for product features, onboarding, and customer enablement programs, working closely with product managers, customer success, and engineering.
Communicate findings clearly through written reports, presentations, and dashboards that inform decisions made by the Director and wider leadership.
Help prioritize what to study next, balancing depth on a few high-value questions against breadth across a fast-moving customer base.
You may be a good fit if you have
A research background in applied social science, human-computer interaction, organizational psychology, or a closely related quantitative/qualitative methods discipline.
Solid mixed-methods skills: survey design, basic psychometrics, structured interviewing, and the judgment to pick the right method for the question at hand.
Hands-on technical ability in Python and data analysis, comfortable enough to run your own analyses without needing to hand off to a data team.
Experience running applied research inside a large, complex organization, or a similar

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

Role overview
Legora is looking for an Editorial Specialist to join our Communications team in London or Stockholm. This role will sit within the Editorial team and help shape how Legora shows up across social, editorial, and owned content channels.
You’ll be responsible for producing sharp, high-quality content that brings Legora’s story to life — from day-to-day social media production to longer-form editorial pieces, customer stories, campaign assets, and thought leadership. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, fast editor, and detail-oriented operator who understands how to turn ideas, news, and company moments into clear, compelling content for a professional audience.
What you’ll do
Produce and publish social media content across Legora’s owned channels, with a focus on LinkedIn.
Draft, edit, and adapt content for a range of formats, including social posts, newsletters, blog posts, customer announcements, event recaps, web copy, and campaign assets.
Work closely with the Editorial and Communications teams to maintain a consistent tone of voice across all external content.
Turn company updates, product developments, customer stories, events, and industry insights into timely, audience-relevant content.
Support the editorial calendar, helping plan, coordinate, and deliver content across channels.
Collaborate with colleagues across Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer, and Leadership to gather inputs and shape them into polished narratives.
Help develop content packages around launches, partnerships, events, customer wins, and thought-leadership campaigns.
Edit and proofread copy to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and alignment with Legora’s messaging.
Monitor social and editorial trends relevant to legal technology, AI, and the legal industry.
Support reporting on content performance and use insights to improve future output.
What we’re looking for
3–5 years of experience in editorial, communications, content marketing, journalism, social media, or a related field.
Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to produce clear, polished copy quickly.
Experience creating content for social media, especially LinkedIn.
Strong editorial judgment and attention to detail.
Ability to translate complex or technical topics into accessible, engaging content.
Comfortable working with stakeholders across different teams and seniority levels.
Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple pieces of content and deadlines at once.
A proactive, collaborative mindset and willingness to work in a fast-moving environment.
Interest in legal technology, AI, professional services, or B2B communications.
Nice to have

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Product (London, United Kingdom)
jobs.description_text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

At Figma we believe design doesn’t end in a file or with your designer - it includes everything that goes into the product you ship: the production code that ties it all together, the systems and developer tools that make that code reliable, the context you provide to our AI agents, and the documentation that keeps everyone on the same page.

The Code Area at Figma is redefining how Designers, PMs and Engineers collaborate. We are responsible for agentic workflows enabling ideation and prototyping on production codebases as well as accelerating the journey from design to code. In 2023, we launched Dev Mode, a suite of features that give developers everything they need to navigate design files and transform designs into code. In 2025, we introduced Figma’s MCP, accelerating how ideas get to production. Looking to the future, we aim to further reduce the barriers between design to code and code to design allowing ideation, prototyping and productionisation to happen seamlessly where it most makes sense.

Our Code organization is expanding, and we’re hiring AI Product Engineers across multiple levels in the UK. We’re looking for people who have built generative AI products and are eager to lead AI efforts end-to-end, from early ideas to production.

Join us in shaping the future of AI at Figma!

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Build and evolve Dev Mode our MCP tools and Make -, Figma’s leading tools for dev/design collaboration
  • Take part in building new 0→1 products within the agentic coding space
  • Collaborate with designers, PMs, and other engineers craft high quality products
  • Be a mentor to, and be mentored by, exceptional peers across engineering, product & design
  • Build strong personal connections with your teammates and help shape Figma’s culture.

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience shipping user-facing features or products as a full-stack developer
  • Demonstrated strong fluency with React & Typescript
  • Experience communicating and working across functions to proactively drive solutions
  • Attention to detail, quality, and craftsmanship
  • High velocity & a focus on user impact

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have experience:

  • Leading large scale engineering projects with high impact
  • Driving XFN projects collaborating with Product, Design, Data & Research
  • Working with user facing LLM and agentic product features
  • Experience curating and developing eval sets and LLMs as judges

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
